How to use Uplink IT Academy

For people preparing CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Linux+ or Cisco CCNA, help desk technicians who want practice on real tools, and career changers moving into IT.

Open Uplink IT Academy ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to academy.lemonshops.app. Every module has free samples, with no account needed.

2

Create an account to save your progress, XP and streak.

3

On Exams, choose your certification and answer the five free questions of a set.

4

Open the Ticket Simulator and resolve one ticket from the queue.

5

Buy only the sets or add-ons you need. There is no required subscription.

02

Features

01

Exams

200 original scenario questions per set, in random order, each with a full explanation and a reference link. Five questions per set are free.

STEPS

  1. Choose the vendor, the exam and the set
  2. Read the explanation after each answer, including correct ones
  3. Flag questions to review later
  4. Use the AI analysis add-on to find weak domains
02

Ticket Simulator

A service desk for Harborline Logistics, a fictional company. You work tickets with a directory, server room, remote desktop, mail console, asset register and documentation.

STEPS

  1. Take a ticket assigned to you
  2. Investigate from the Tools menu
  3. Apply the fix and write the resolution
  4. Submit; each step and the fix are graded
03

Network Lab

Command-line labs for Windows, Linux, security and Cisco IOS. Each lab has a brief, objectives and checks that pass as you enter the right commands.

STEPS

  1. Choose a track: A+, Network+, Security+, Linux+, CCNA, Meraki or UniFi
  2. Read the brief and the objectives
  3. Type commands; type help for hints
  4. Read the concept note once every check passes
04

Troubleshoot

A coach that works through a fault with you: what to check first, what each result means, what to try next.

STEPS

  1. Start a case
  2. Answer with what you would actually do
  3. Read the feedback at each step
05

Courses and Career Agent

Short courses on the concepts behind the questions, and an agent that reads your resume and lists the next steps toward network engineering.

STEPS

  1. Follow a course lesson by lesson
  2. Paste your resume into the Career Agent
  3. Update the plan every week
06

Network Docs

For businesses: order documentation of an existing network. Fill in the questionnaire, pay for a tier, and receive diagrams and a PDF by email.

STEPS

  1. Start a request in Network Docs
  2. Answer the site questionnaire
  3. Pay for the tier you need
  4. Receive the pack by email
03Tips
  • Every module works on a phone.
  • Read the explanations; they carry most of the learning.
  • One ticket a day builds more skill than a hundred extra questions.
04FAQ
Do I have to pay to try it?

No. Five questions per set, sample tickets and sample labs are free.

Which exams are covered?

CompTIA A+ (Core 1 and Core 2), Network+, Security+, Linux+ and Cisco CCNA.

Does it work on a phone?

Yes. It was designed for phones first.

How do I get help?

Use the contact form on the academy or write to hello@lemonshops.app.
